ruleDefinitions.name: ESXi VM Kill Via ESXCLI
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the "esxcli" command with the "vm" and "kill" flag in order to kill/shutdown a specific VM.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/esxcli$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*vm\\ process.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*kill.*")))
